cohort: Singleton births in Norway between 1999-2019, gestational weeks 37-42 (n = 1 127 945)
finding: A significant increase in labor inductions was accompanied by a modest decline in fetal deaths, but no decline in other adverse perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: There was a slight increase in operative deliveries, with acute cesarean sections increasing from 6.5% to 9.3% and vacuum and/or forceps-assisted deliveries increasing from 7.8% to 10.4%.
